scope: Correct and inertly qualify launcher paths, then execute one fresh finite CPU diagnosis of same-content authority-file replacement invalidation; no ledger repair, aggregate or native start
placement_limits: Both fresh worker scratch directories live beneath this turn workspace on its actual filesystem. Record each scratch st_dev and /proc/self/mountinfo. Same host filesystem does not reconstruct historical allocation or timing.

slots.intervention: Unmodified test method and filesystem operations; custom TestResult only records the actual subtest outcomes. Original temporary fixture cleanup remains enabled.

For both file names, use real Ledger.begin then original bytes, unlink and write_bytes(original). Two no-held-FD cases preserve original descriptor lifetime. Two separately labeled retained-read-FD controls intentionally keep the old unlinked object alive until after reservation/poison observation.

observation_fields: Real source commit/tree, status, exact local source/protocol/test/contract hashes before and after
Interpreter digest/version, platform/machine, PID/process group, working directory, TMPDIR path/stat and Linux mountinfo
Actual original-method result including all ten subtests and complete assertion/error traces
Case invocation ID, stored marker/journal identities and exact original/recreated/post-first-reserve/post-poison bytes plus SHA-256
Before/unlinked/recreated/final path existence, device, inode, mode, nlink, uid/gid, size, atime/mtime/ctime nanoseconds
Before-unlink and before-reserve live descriptor inventories; original-object matching descriptor count; held-control fstat and nlink after unlink; closure of held descriptor
First reservation return or full LedgerError cause chain, accounting/stopped/uncertain snapshots; exactly one second reservation only after first rejected
Worker start attempts, actual exit/timeout status, confirmed reaping, remaining process-group members and child-start audit events
preservation: A pre-opened fsynced observations.jsonl records exact originals as hex before each unlink and records every later phase. No evidence write occurs in the unlink/recreate gap. Supplementary binary snapshots are written after the four cases. Original authority/output fixtures are retained; descriptor resources and worker processes are closed/reaped. Original baseline unittest temporary fixtures are removed by its original cleanup.
instrumentation_effects: lstat/fstat, /proc enumeration, additional reads and event writes/fsync affect timing and allocation state. The no-held-FD gap adds a missing-path lstat but no opened original-file handle or inode allocation. Retained-FD controls intentionally change inode lifetime. Neither can reconstruct C228 exactly or change its failing result.
hypotheses: H1: original creation handles are closed, so unlink can free the object; same-content recreation can reuse (st_dev, st_ino), satisfying unchanged _append checks and avoiding rejection/poisoning.

H2: when original object is explicitly retained through an open descriptor, its nlink becomes zero and the recreated path normally receives a different identity, causing unchanged guard rejection and terminal poisoning.
H3: isolated allocations may not reuse an inode in this finite sequence; that outcome leaves historical mechanism unresolved rather than authorizing retries.
stop_conditions: Any source/interpreter/harness/approval mismatch prevents worker execution; the fresh output directory, once claimed, is never reused.
Slot1 may pass or fail only the two expected same-content replacement subtests with LedgerError not raised; any setup/error/skip/incomplete/unexpected failure stops before slot2.
Timeout, unknown worker outcome, failed cleanup, forbidden child attempt, missing complete result, unexpected descriptor, path or exception stops; no replacement invocation or additional case.

After the two slots or any concrete blocker, stop product execution, preserve observations, independently review conclusion and hand off. No repair, test expectation change, full-cohort or aggregate replay.
interpretation_rules: An observed unlink, absent path and same dev/inode after recreation establishes identity-number reuse in that actual case; matching bytes alone does not establish object continuity.
A returned reservation after identical-byte replacement is a real missing rejection; report stopped/uncertain state without adding a second mutation that could conceal it.
A poison check counts only after an actual first rejection; after an unexpected successful reserve, a later order error would not demonstrate replacement poisoning.
An isolated original-method pass cannot erase C228; diagnostic facts may establish a mechanism under observed conditions without recovering C228 absent inode sequence.
Held-descriptor controls test a proposed causal explanation only and do not constitute a product repair or native authority.

independent_approval_required.plan_sha256: Reviewer supplies actual SHA-256 of this file

approval_and_recovery_gate: Root must observe independent approval, completed exact-source restoration and confirmed durable preservation of plan, harness, qualification and approval before the sole absolute launcher invocation.
path_resolution: Caller plan and approval paths are resolved strictly before reading. Source/output paths inside a plan resolve relative to the absolute plan directory if not already absolute. Exact reviewed worker and actual launcher paths are resolved strictly. Every actual child script/input/scratch path is absolute before its cwd changes. Output must be outside source and its parent must exist.

qualification.limitation: All qualification workers are harmless stand-ins in a tiny independent Git fixture; synthetic result shapes are not ledger evidence.

retained_worker_provenance.meaning: Worker bytes and observations retain C229 labels by exact reuse. The separately versioned C230 plan and launcher identify this new execution.

prelaunch_requirements: Root verifies audit/input-offline-restore.json completed successfully at the exact source commit/tree and source status is clean
Independent approval binds exact plan, launcher and worker hashes after author freezes bytes
Root observes confirmed durable preservation of source, plan, qualification and approval
New output directory does not exist; no C229 run directory is resumed or overwritten
Root performs the one absolute outer invocation; all agents refrain from other product execution
